verdict.rationale: Cua documents the plumbing for unattended multi-app work. Cua Driver lets an agent drive native apps in the background with its own cursor. Unattended access can be granted for saved credentials. Named agents can run daemon-fired routines with notifications and pause/resume. However, how reliably tasks complete depends on the agent driving it. The one hands-on report (an older 0.1.29 build with a small local model) describes the agent typing in the wrong place and runs failing to connect, so hands-off completion is unproven. Missing for 10: documented cross-app task success rates or published benchmark results, independent corroboration that long multi-step tasks finish unattended, and documented recovery from mid-task failures such as popups or loading states.
